propositions.text: The existence of God can be proved by argument from the world of experience.
The argument from contingency is a sound argument for God's existence.
'Necessary' can be applied meaningfully only to analytic propositions, not to beings.
The world as a whole has a cause or explanation beyond itself.
It is legitimate to ask what the cause of the world is.
